systems.country_label: Payments moved from SWIFT MT to the ISO 20022 message format from 22 November 2025, per a joint Central Bank of Seychelles and Seychelles Bankers Association notice
systems.owner: Central Bank of Seychelles; commercial banks

note: Payments moved to the ISO 20022 message format is a system built to a standard and a sector rule for banks; it names no membership, adopted national standard, public-body requirement or committee seat.
